overview.Name: Eve Holding, Inc.
overview.Description: Eve Holding, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, develops urban air mobility solutions in the United States. It is involved in the design and production of electrical vertical take-off and landing vehicles (eVTOLs); provision of eVTOL service and support services, including material, maintenance, technical support, training, ground handling, and data services; and development of Vector, an urban air traffic management systems. The company is based in Melbourne, Florida. Eve Holding, Inc. is a subsidiary of Embraer Aircraft Holding, Inc.
